maddeler.e:
يمتعض (form VIII)
# يَمْتَعِضُ (yamtaʕiḍu) /jam.ta.ʕi.dˤu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِمْتَعَضَ (imtaʕaḍa)
# يُمْتَعَضُ (yumtaʕaḍu) /jum.ta.ʕa.dˤu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِمْتَعَضَ (imtaʕaḍa)
# يَمْتَعِضَ (yamtaʕiḍa) /jam.ta.ʕi.dˤa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِمْتَعَضَ (imtaʕaḍa)
#
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
